egress.terms: Access to metadata and data files is provided over standard protocols such as HTTP and OAI-PMH.

record.tooling: Email self-registration with a personal work area; HTTP + OAI-PMH read; DOI minting per record; versioning of published records. AiiDA provenance integration is the native client for the 50 GB tier.
record.chaining: Unlimited records x 5 GB (or 50 GB for AiiDA databases). 100 records at 5 GB = 500 GB; the 50 GB AiiDA tier halves that to 10 records.

record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 5 GB / 50 GB per record; moderation gate ('Once you submit your record for publication it will be reviewed by the Materials Cloud moderators'), scope-gated to computational materials science, and moderators explicitly police 'excessive submission rate'.
record.reliability_note: EPFL-hosted and stable, but moderation is substantive (refereeable-quality requirement) and rate-policed. The opposite of an anonymous dump. Data survives; throughput is editorially throttled.
